acceptance_boundary: Independent source safety review plus read-only final build, generated-input, receipt, log and ELF correspondence. This does not establish silicon behavior or board qualification.

writes: This independent safety review receipt only.
reviewer_actions.method: Read original source text and selected page pixels; trace generated helper templates and shared runtime paths; independently parse, compare and hash data, manifests, receipts, build logs and ARM ELF structures. Producer-run validation is identified separately.

visually_inspected_pages: CN UM PDF208/printed207: TIME/ALARMA reset and fields
CN UM PDF87/printed86: configuration-only versus working APBEN1 gates
own_sources.page_receipt_scope: Producer source check records 77 own pages; this reviewer directly read the consequential original-source pages for detector/factory LSI, LSE fields/status/IRQs, native gates/AUTOTRIM, RTC reset/compensation, LCKR, parts/routes and electrical constraints, rather than claiming an independent render of all 77 pages.

scope_reviews.finding: Only CW32L083RBT6, RCT6, RCS6, MCT6 and VCT6. Init-only board-qualified nominal 32768 Hz crystal or bypass; 1.65–5.5 V and -40–85 C. No family aliases, arbitrary nominal frequency or measured crystal-startup claim. Own datasheet part/pad/electrical rows match the policy.

Own CN UM PDF81/printed80 defines DRIVER, AMP, WAITCYCLE, MODE and STABLE only. rcc_lse_native_consumers applies to L052/L083; rcc_lse_startup_analog stays L052-only. L083 preserves reserved bits and has no PDRIVER/PAMP or inferred phase switch.

Own factory LSI bounds 31816–33784 Hz agree with RTC source metadata and DS PDF55/table7-18 under general operating conditions. Actual LSI trim is compared with factory halfword 0x00100A02; erased storage or a live mismatch rejects. A stopped mismatch requires repeated unchanged disabled/nonstable states, no selected native consumer/detector/ready owner, before a masked trim-only write. Active, automatic and reserved AUTOTRIM states reject; no active calibration is performed. Factory-valid live trim and WAIT are preserved, then trim/WAIT/enable/stability are frozen and checked.

All 13 own reset/mask tuples match CN UM PDF204–212, including L083 ALARMA 0x00120000. Controls-first double reset-like snapshots cover COMPEN independently of SOURCE and raw-clock wake independently of START. No KEY, ACCESS or ICR write, reset, flag clear or WINDOW wait occurs in source admission.

All six UARTs use native SOURCE; L052 SORCE remains untouched. AUTOTRIM configuration gate inspection preserves its state. LPTIM/LCD off working gates remain off; enabled gates are inspected without local writes and gate stability is checked. SYSCLK/MCO/direct routes/GPIO filters and package-specific LSI routes are covered. Reserved L083 MCO selectors reject.

PC14/PC15 ownership matches exact package bonds. Crystal keeps both analog input pads; bypass only changes PC14 digital-input admission and leaves PC15 free. Native LCKR, AF, pulls, open drain, filters and interrupt enables are checked without unlocking pads. Current STABLE is distinguished from LSERDY history; ready/fault IRQ ownership and sticky failures are preserved. CLKCCS is not repurposed as RTC recovery.

Enabled LSE reuse requires matching parameters/pads and a healthy factory LSI detector; CCS-off retained LSE rejects. Timeout/fault retains enable, detector, reservations and diagnostics, with no capability publication, teardown rollback, RTC fallback or migration. Supported initialization excludes concurrent raw-PAC/DMA/NMI mutation. Config.lse=None skips the new requested-source admission/start path.

All prior profiles and policy hashes are unchanged. Old eight nonnative parts retain false/false cfg values; old three L052 parts retain true/true values and prior writes/branches. UART spelling and L052 AF input remain equivalent. New margin and MCO-range rejection are L083-only. Shared HSI/HSE/PLL backend, electrical facts, RTC facts, schemas and authority lock are byte-identical. Native IR differs only by three LSE enums/associations; the reuse ledger differs only by the bounded history entry.

margin_review.manufacturer_detector: 128 LSE events during 256 LSI cycles, own CN UM PDF65/printed64 and PDF76/printed75
margin_review.overflow_proof: u32 values widen to u64 before multiplication; each product is less than 2^40.
margin_review.ordering: Lse::bounds is called by Config::frequencies, and try_init invokes frequencies before Peripherals::take and RCC MMIO.
margin_review.rationale: The additional edge is an explicit conservative software counting-phase margin. It is not a manufacturer-specified threshold, measured timing bound, continuous-health guarantee or proof that an oscillator with a rejected loose declaration fails.

separate_producer_data_test_evidence.kind: One exact cw32-data-gen negative-data test; not a HAL test

limitations: No assertion of board crystal/load/electrical qualification, oscillator accuracy, bounded physical startup or continuous source availability.
Reviewer ran no Cargo commands or HAL tests. Producer-run build/data-test results were inspected and bound to hashes.
Acceptance applies to this exact source and generated manifest pair.
